references.text: Introduces the grain offering (mincha) with fine flour and oil, which is the basis for the offering described in verse 7.
Describes another type of grain offering baked in an oven or on a griddle, parallel to the grain offering in a pan mentioned in verse 7.
Gives further instructions about the grain offering, including preparation with oil.
Refers to a grain offering baked in an oven and prepared in a pan or on a griddle, which belongs to the priest who offers it.
Mentions unleavened bread made from fine wheat flour, resembling the ingredients of the grain offering.
